expiration_value: No notice of October being the highest October temperature on record (i.e global temperature anomaly greater than 1.03 degrees C)
rules_primary: If the global temperature anomaly as reported for October is greater than 1.03°C, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary: Please be aware that this contract relies on government data as its Underlying that may be impacted by a potential government shutdown. If no data is available at the Source Agency, then the Contract will resolve to No.
subtitle: >1.03°C
title: Will October have the highest temperature for any October on record?
